Experimental_Design.Conditions: 6 conditions (good-self, neutral-self, bad-self, good-other, neutral-other, bad-other); 2 (matching) x 2 (reference: self/other) x 3 (moral character: good/neutral/bad), within-subject

exp3a.detail: Explicit self-referencing test (self-binding vs valence account). extraIV1 = moral valence of the SHAPE-side concept (Good/Neutral/Bad, derived from raw Shape text; author's Load_save_data.r derives Valence from the shape side too). Matching = YesNoResp (true matching status). Shape = geometry file (Target); Shape identity = raw Shape text (e.g. Goodself); Label = Chinese label text (好我/好人/凡我/凡人/坏我/坏人). No-response trials (empty response, RT=0) coded ACC=NA/RT_ms=NA. Practice trials retained with Phase=Practice. Subject re-coded +3000 per author. Table 1 N=38 (35): 2 practice-only subjects (271, 35) + 1 low-accuracy excluded.
